"You're going to tell me everything you know or else!" The Mist captain yells at a wounded farmer, pointing a sword at his neck. The farmer appears to be in a trance. Beneath their feet lie the bodies of warriors who tried fighting off the mist shinobi. The farmer gives no answer. "Ugh! This guy is useless! Tonima, use your genjutsu to figure out where those Anbu went!" "On it boss!" Tonima moves towards the old man and weaves the signs to enter his mind. Near instantaneously, Tonima is surrounded by a pool of red water and is greeted by a pair of ominous black and red eyes in the sky. He recoils in horror in a pool of sweat. Before the captain and the other squad can ask what is wrong, a voice can be heard in the distance. "You mist shinobi really are all brawn no brain." A man walks from behind the trees and faces towards the Mist. As the Mist began exclaiming as the mysterious figure, the man calmly responds. "The residents of this village died a long time ago." The eyes of the man turn black with an ominous red as the corpses and the wounded villager begin rapidly producing a black, cancerous growth from their bodies. In a flash, the bodies erupt, turning the Mist to ash." -Kikushi Uchiha

The Long Road, Ch. 30 excerpt.

Blood Architects

The Chinoike is a clan that was active in the land of lightning then exiled to the valley of hell in the land of hot water which then led to peace for generations until a civil war broke out and many of the Chinoike clan died. In the present day, only a few Chinoike remain, scattered throughout the world.

Chinoike Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Int, +1 Dex

Speed: You base walking speed is 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Medicine

Blood Release Affinity: You begin with the Water release or Medical release affinity (Pick one).

Chinoike Techniques: The Chinoike have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Chinoike Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

| #### Ketsuryugan / Will Amp / Your Ketsuryugan grants you the following bonuses; / Crimson Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Blood Sight, a unique special sense, that allows you to perceive creatures that have iron in their Blood (Humans, Animals etc.), even if they are invisible. This special sense does not penetrate walls or barriers. This increases to 60-feet at 11th level. / Blood As A Resource. If you or another creature has ranks of Bleed within 30 feet of you when you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword, you can consume 1 rank of Bleed to gain the benefit of a sufficient source of water, where applicable. / Lifeforce Casting. When you cast a Chinoike Hijutsu, you can spend 2 Crimson Charges to use its Blood Detonation effect. |

Chinoike Features

Ketsuryugan

1st Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

One of the Hidden Cloud villages noble Dojutsu. The Ketsuryugan is an eye of fearsome power and potent illusory skill. You gain access to the Ketsuryugan. You may, as a bonus action, activate this Dojutsu, which remains active for up to 1o minutes at a time, after which, you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again.

Your Ketsuryugan grants some passive bonuses, but also adapts to your unique fighting style via special techniques known as Crimson Evocations. You begin with 2 such Crimson Evocations that you can only use while your Ketsuryugan is active. You can only use these abilities by spending Crimson Charges. You have a number of Crimson Charges equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You gain additional Crimson Evocations at 7th and 15th level. You regain all spent Crimson Charges when you complete a rest.

Bloody Resilience

Internal or biological attacks are far less effective against someone who can control their own blood. By spending 1 Crimson Charge, at the beginning of your turn, for the next minute, you gain resistance to Acid, Poison and Necrotic damage and effects that would inflict the Bleed or Envenomed conditions.

Beginning at 7th level, you can instead select one willing allied creature within 30 feet of you and spend 1 Crimson Charge, granting them the effects of this evocation for the next minute. You can only affect up to two creatures, including yourself, at once. Using this on an additional creatures ends the oldest active effect.

Beginning at 15th level, when you or a creature within 30 feet of you has ranks of Bleed, you can spend 1 Crimson Charge, to reduce the ranks of Bleed the select creature has to 0. Then you roll 1d8 for every rank removed, gaining temporary hit points equal to the result.

Cold Blooded

Water release jutsu you cast is infused with your blood, turning it crimson red. Each time you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword; you can spend 1 Crimson Charge. When you do, its damage type becomes Necrotic and affected creatures with ranks of Bleed suffers a penalty to their saving throws against the cast jutsu, equal to the ranks of Bleed they have.

Beginning at 11th level, creatures that fail their saving throw vs a Hijutsu you cast, has their circulatory network infiltrated by spending 2 Crimson Charges, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are Stunned until the end of their next turn. A creature Stunned in this way cannot be affected by this feature moving forward until you complete a rest.

Circulatory Supercharge

You can supercharge the circulation of blood in yourself or allied creatures by infusing your chakra into their circulatory system. As an Action, by spending 2 Crimson Charges, you release a pulse of chakra in a 20-foot radius, centered on you, affecting all willing allied creatures of your choice within range. Affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to their AC, a +20 bonus to their speed, and gain the Surge special action until the beginning of your next turn.

Surge. You can use this special on your turn to take the Dash or Disengage actions or make one Unarmed or Weapon attack.

Beginning at 7th level, all affected creatures also gain a rank of Mastery to their attacks for the same duration.

Beginning at 15th level, creature can use the Surge special action to fulfil a feature, jutsu or ability that requires an Action to use. If they do, they gain 2 ranks of Exhaustion.

Life Force Drain

Water and Medical release jutsu you cast no longer relies on your blood to amplify it alone. You can instead siphon the lifeforce of enemies it affects. When you cast a Jutsu with the Water or Medical release keywords, you can spend your Bonus Action and 1 Crimson Charge to mold any excess chakra to drain the life from enemies. When you do, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level and affected creatures must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. If your jutsu already forces a saving throw, then this effect also applies on a failure. On a failure they take Chakra damage equal to the amount of temporary hit points you gain, and you gain temporary chakra equal to the result.

Beginning at 11th level, you learn to drain the chakra from barriers, reappropriating their strength for your own uses. When you use this feature and the target creature is protected by a Barrier with hit points, you can spend 1 additional Crimson Charge, to reduce its hit points by an amount equal to your level. When you do, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level, instead of only your level.

Mental Acuity Boost

You learn to safely increase the flow of blood to the Brain, to increase the targets ability to think and react mentally. When you or an allied creature within 30 feet of you would fail a saving throw, you can spend 2 Crimson Charges, to boost the brain processing power of the affected creature. When you do, they gain a rank of Mastery to their saves result and can move up to half of their speed away from the source of whatever harmed them.

Beginning at 7th level, this increases to two ranks of Mastery to the failed save and if they take psychic damage, they gain temporary hit points equal to half the psychic damage took for the next minute.

Beginning at 15th level, if the failed save would inflict ranks of a Mental condition, you can spend 1 additional Crimson Charge, to reduce the ranks of each Mental condition gained by 2.

Sanguine Illusions

You learn to channel Genjutsu through blood just as well as you can through the eyes. When you cast a Genjutsu with the Visual sensory keyword, you can spend 1 Crimson Charge as part of that casting, to change that sensory keyword to Inhale. When you do, the saving throw instead becomes Constitution and on a failure, they also gain 1 rank of Bleed, as blood begin to leak from their eyes, ears, nose or mouth.

Beginning at 11th level, when a creature fails their saving throw vs a Genjutsu you cast with the Inhale keyword, for the duration of that Genjutsu, each time they cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Bleed on a failure.

Illusory Pain Receptor

You learn to amplify every sensation an enemy feels from long lasting damage. As a Bonus action, select one creature you can see within 60 feet of you, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, for the next minute, damage they take as the result of a Condition they have, is increased by +2, for each rank they have. This increases to +4 at 15th level.

Crimson Weaponry

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Chinoike clan are one of the original noble clans tied to the Daimyo of the land of lightning, known for their unique ability to manipulate iron rich liquids, such as blood, their techniques are often infused with the Land of Lightnings philosophy of martial skill. When initiative is rolled, you can create a small incision on yourself, deep enough to draw blood, but otherwise harmless.

If you do, you can select one weapon from the Blade, Thrown, or Flail weapon groups and conjure this weapon, formed entirely of your blood. This weapon gains the Critical and Blood Bound weapon properties and you become proficient in it for the remainder of initiative. If the weapon has the ammunition property, and it cannot be reduced in size, below a d8.

The Blood Bound Weapon property is a unique property unique to weapons formed with this feature.

Blood Bound. Weapons with this property can be used to make weapon attacks using the ability modifier as chosen by your Hijutsu Flexibility clan trait and you cannot be disarmed of this weapon. Other creatures attempting to wield this weapon has it dissolve into a pool of blood. This weapon can be used in place of a Combat Scroll to qualify for a Chakra Stance and if you cast a Bukijutsu with this weapon of C-Rank or lower, you can use either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu ability modifier, once per turn.

Crimson Release Manifestation

7th Level Clan Feature

The Chinoike clan has a unique talent for manifesting their Blood manipulation and Ketsuryugan bloodline limit, which grants them a close affinity with both Water and Medical Release. You gain the second release you didn’t select from Blood Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Water or Medical release keywords, you can change the damage type to necrotic.

Also, you’ve learned to isolate toxins and foreign substances within blood. By spending 1 minute focusing on a creature that is Envenomed, suffering from a disease or infected with some special substance or virus, you can extract it from them, ending whatever hostile or negative effects they could be suffering from as a result.

Crimson Pact

11th Level Clan Feature

| #### Crimson Pact / Fortitude Amp / You are under a bond of blood. You gain the following benefits; / Bonded Ally. You can sense the direction of the other creature with the matching Crimson Pact so long as they are within 10 miles of you. You also become aware if they are dead, without chakra or have Physical conditions. / Blood of my Blood. While within 60 feet of your matching Crimson Pact, if either of you regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu’s casting, the other creature gains temporary hit points equal to the result of Hit points gained, which last for 1 minute. / Bonded Lifeforce. If you fall to 0 hit points, your matching Crimson Pact can reduce their maximum hit points by 20 until you both complete a long rest. If they do, you instead fall to 20 hit points. |

By leaving traces of your chakra within the blood of your allies, you can form a bond of blood with them known as a Crimson Pact. This Crimson Pact is represented as a special marking on the bonded creature of either of your designs, in a place where blood flows strongest (chest, wrist, neck, back, etc.). You can perform this ritual over the course of a Long Rest with a willing creature you can reach. You can only have one creature actively Bonded at a time.

While bonded both you and the allied creature gain the Crimson Pact status. If either creature willingly dismisses the bond, dies, or is the target of an effect that can dispel a Jutsu of B-Rank or lower, this effect ends on them.

Crimson Architect

15th Level Clan Feature

| #### Crimson Pact / Fortitude Amp / You are under a bond of blood. You gain the following benefits; / Bonded Ally. You can sense the direction of the other creature with the matching Crimson Pact so long as they are within 10 miles of you. You also become aware if they are dead, without chakra or have Physical conditions. / Blood of my Blood. While within 60 feet of your matching Crimson Pact, if either of you regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu’s casting, the other creature gains temporary hit points equal to the result of Hit points gained, which last for 1 minute. / Bonded Lifeforce. If you fall to 0 hit points, your matching Crimson Pact can reduce their maximum hit points by 20 until you both complete a long rest. If they do, you instead fall to 20 hit points. |

You shower the battlefield in your ichor, baptizing everything in blood. While you have your Ketsuryugan active, you can, spend 1 action to build your Crimson Domain. You can use this feature once per long rest.

When you do, you radiate chakra and blood droplets a 40-foot radius, centered on you, for the next minute. For the duration you gain the following;

Creatures with ranks of Bleed that are in the radius, that would regain hit points, instead regains half of the listed amount. You gain the remaining half.

Creatures with ranks of Bleed that begin their turn in this radius must move at least 30 feet, fully circulating their own blood, or they lose their Reaction until the beginning of their next turn.

When an allied creature gains hit points or temporary hit points, you can select one other allied or willing creature and they gain half of the hit points or temporary hit points gained.

When a creature with 2 or more ranks of Bleed would move into a space not within your domain, you can spend your Reaction, to reduce their remaining speed to 0, and then they must move 15 feet closer to you.
